app.name: fitcher
app.tagline: Every number comes from a query you can open.

sample.tooltip: This part runs on sample data until its service is connected.
sample.unmatched: I can only answer this demo's sample questions until the chat is connected to your data. Try one of the suggested questions.

ui.composerPlaceholder: Ask a question about your data…
ui.composerHint: Answers come from read-only SQL you can open. Check numbers before you share them.
ui.stoppedText: You stopped this run before it finished. No result is shown.
ui.r_kpi: KPI needs one row with a single number
ui.r_donut_groups: Pie needs 6 or fewer non-negative groups
ui.r_donut_time: Time series can't be shown as a pie
ui.r_donut_series: Pie needs one category and one number
ui.r_line: Line needs a date or ordered axis
ui.r_grouped: Grouped bar needs two categories and one number
ui.r_bar: Bar needs a category and a number
ui.chartAria: {type} chart of {cols}. The same rows are in the data table.
ui.notePlaceholder: For example: wrong period, missing product, the number looks too high
ui.thanks: Thanks. Your note goes to the people who maintain this pack.
ui.blockedText: The question didn't pass the safety check, so nothing was queried.
ui.deniedTitle: This data isn't available to your role
ui.deniedHint: Nothing was queried. If you need this, ask an admin to review your access.
ui.oosTitle: That's outside what I can answer
ui.oosText: I answer questions about {pack} data. You could try:
ui.failedTitle: I couldn't get a valid result
ui.failedText: The query failed 3 times, so I stopped instead of guessing. Here is the last attempt and the database error.
ui.emptyText: The query ran without errors and returned 0 rows. Try a wider date range or fewer filters.
ui.networkText: The answer stopped streaming. Nothing from this run was saved.
ui.greetingSub: Ask a question about {pack} data. Every number comes from a SQL query you can open and check.
ui.signInTrust: Answers are computed by read-only SQL on your company's data and checked against your access. You can open every query.
ui.ssoNote: You'll continue on your company's sign-in page.
ui.chartEdited: Done. The chart above now shows a {type}. Same rows, no new query.
ui.chartEditBlocked: {type} isn't available for that result: {reason}. I kept the current chart.
ui.chartEditNone: There's no chart in this conversation yet. Ask a data question first.
ui.proposalsNote: Questions mined from disliked or failed chats. Replace every masked value and test-run the SQL before approving.
ui.useSpec: Use this spec when the same question is asked
ui.specHelp: Pack ids only. Lists are comma-separated; one filter per line: column = value, column != value, column in a, b or column not in a, b. Periods come from the question.
ui.specInvalid: Check this part of the spec: {text}
ui.dropSub: PDF, DOCX, MD, TXT or XLSX, up to 20 MB each
ui.dropBlocked: Uploads are paused while the pack is compiling.
ui.duplicate: {name} is already uploaded. Delete the existing copy to replace it.
ui.compiling: Pack is compiling. Uploads resume when it finishes.
ui.deleteDocText: The document leaves search, and pack items that cite it get flagged for review. This can't be undone.
ui.question: Question
ui.costsNote: Estimated from token counts and list prices. Your provider's invoice is the source of truth.
ui.noItemsText: Change the status filter to see more.
ui.heroTitle: What would you like to know, {name}?
ui.heroSub: Answers come from read-only SQL on {pack} data. You can open every query.
ui.signInSub: Sign in to ask questions about {pack} data.
ui.signInFailed: Sign-in did not complete. Try again.
ui.testEmpty: Run the formula against the data to preview its rows before approving.
ui.noTestText: Glossary terms and policies are checked against their evidence, not run.
ui.desc_review: Glossary terms, metrics and policies drafted for the pack. Approve what the evidence supports.
ui.desc_documents: Company documents searched for definitions. Choose which roles can see each one.
ui.desc_runs: Every question asked, with its trace, duration and estimated cost.
ui.desc_audit: Access decisions for every query, newest first.
ui.desc_costs: Estimated model spend over the last 14 days.
ui.deleteChatText: It is removed from your history. Runs stay in the audit log.
ui.deleteGroupText: Only the group is deleted. Its conversations move back to Recent.
ui.desc_datasets: Tables the assistant may query, with their columns and who can read them. Edited in the pack, read-only here.
ui.desc_feedback: Likes and dislikes from the chat. Turn a disliked answer into a proposed example for review.
ui.desc_evaluation: Results of the pack's evaluation set. The pack is enabled only when execution match reaches the threshold.
ui.desc_users: People who have signed in with the company account, and the role that decides what they can open.
ui.evalDone: Evaluation started; its report appears here when it finishes
ui.name: Name
ui.usersNote: People appear here after their first sign-in with the company account. Their role decides which sections and data they can open. A role change takes effect at their next sign-in or token refresh, within a few minutes.
ui.disableText: They can no longer sign in to fitcher. Their past runs stay in the audit log.
ui.roleDesc_analyst: Asks questions in the chat app.
ui.roleDesc_pack_reviewer: Reviews pack items, documents, datasets and feedback.
ui.roleDesc_admin: Watches runs, audit and costs, and manages people.
ui.draftConfirmText: Drafting pack items from {name} sends the document to the model gateway, which bills each call. Drafted items wait in Review until someone approves them.
ui.evalConfirmText: Running the evaluation set asks every case through the model gateway, which bills each call. Cases run one at a time, so it can take several minutes.
ui.notFound: This item doesn't exist or was deleted.
ui.loadFailed: This section couldn't load. Try again in a moment.
ui.desc_models: Which model serves each task. A chat tier can move only to a model whose latest pack evaluation passed without regression.
ui.modelsNote: A change applies to every user within 30 seconds and is recorded in the admin audit log.
ui.ineligibleAliases: Models that cannot be chosen yet
ui.embedLocked: The embedding model changes only in the server settings, followed by a full reindex of the search collections.
ui.catalogUnavailable: The model gateway did not list its models ({reason}); no tier can be changed now.
ui.changeTierText: {tier} moves from {from} to {to} for every user.
ui.tierDesc_fast: Routing, term extraction, summaries and chart tie-breaks.
ui.tierDesc_sql_small: SQL for simple questions: one measure, at most one breakdown, one period, no comparison or top N.
ui.tierDesc_sql_gen: SQL for every other question, and the first retry after a failed simple attempt.
ui.tierDesc_embed: Vectors for search over the pack.
